title: Implement Resend email service
description: Implement the live email service using the Resend API. Used when EMAIL_MODE=live. Requires RESEND_API_KEY in settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads RESEND_API_KEY from settings table (not process.env)
Returns EmailResult with mode='live' and the Resend messageId
Throws a descriptive error if RESEND_API_KEY is not configured
Verify by calling send() in a test (use a test API key or mock the SDK)

steps.details: Run `npm install resend`. Import in the service file.

Export class `ResendEmailService implements EmailService`. Constructor: accept apiKey string. Implement `send(payload)`: create Resend client with apiKey. Call `resend.emails.send({ from, to, subject, html })`. Return `{ success: true, messageId: data.id, mode: 'live' }`.
If `resend.emails.send` returns an error object, return `{ success: false, mode: 'live', error: error.message }`. Do not throw.
